user: How do I add a new employee?
answer:
To add a new employee:

1. Go to People → Hire (or Employees → + Add employee).
2. Choose the worker type and location: pick Employee/Contractor/EOR and set where they’re located. If hiring a W‑2 employee, a four-step wizard appears: Employee details → Payroll schedule → Configure documents → Review & invite. A Bulk Upload option is available for many hires.
3. Complete the wizard (assign payroll schedule, choose onboarding paperwork, review and send the invite).

Note: The new hire lands in Onboarding (not Active) and is not payable until every onboarding step is complete — the common hold-up is completing Form I‑9 Section 2, which the employer must finish within 3 business days of the employee’s first day.

user: How do I add a vendor?
answer:
Go to Niural Pay → Vendors → Add vendor (or click + Add new vendor from inside Add bill). Then complete the sections and click Create vendor:

1. General information: Vendor type (Individual or Business), Vendor country, Vendor name (legal registered name), Entity, Department.
2. Contact information: Contact number, Email address.
3. Tax & compliance details: EIN and upload a Tax document (required if you will generate 1099s).
4. Vendor agreement: Upload contract (PDF, DOC, DOCX). Niural compares bills to this contract to produce anomaly findings.
5. KYB verification: tick Mark this vendor as KYB verified once the check has been run.
6. Home or business address and Mailing address.
7. Click Create vendor.

Note: KYB verified status is shown separately from Active and an unverified vendor can prevent payments from proceeding.

user: What does KYB status mean for a vendor?

user: How do I create an invoice for a customer?
answer:
Go to Niural Pay → Invoices → Create invoice and complete the form:

1. Select the Customer.
2. Enter an Invoice title (shows in the list).
3. Link a Contract if one exists (otherwise it will show as Unlinked).
4. Choose Entity and Department.
5. Fill Invoice details: Reference number, Currency, Invoice code, Invoice date, Payment term (e.g. One Week) and Payment due.
6. Add line items: Item, Quantity, Rate, Discount %, Tax rate, Amount.
7. (Optional) Add Notes and an Additional attachment.
8. Check Subtotal, Additional discount %, Tax amount and Net amount.
9. Answer whether this is a recurring invoice — Yes will put it on a schedule visible under the Schedules tab.
10. Click Create invoice.

Note: creating the invoice does not send it. It will appear with status “Email not sent” until you send it to the customer.

user: How do I add a vendor?
answer:
To add a vendor: Go to Niural Pay → Vendors → Add vendor (or click + Add new vendor from inside the Add bill form).

Complete the form sections:
1. General information — select Vendor type (Individual or Business), Vendor country, enter Vendor name (legal registered name), Entity, Department.
2. Contact information — Contact number and Email address.
3. Tax & compliance details — enter EIN and upload a Tax document if you will generate 1099s for this vendor.
4. Vendor agreement — upload the contract (PDF, DOC or DOCX). Niural uses this to compare bills and produce anomaly findings.
5. KYB verification — tick “Mark this vendor as KYB verified” once the check has actually been run (KYB status is separate from Active and an unverified vendor can block payments).
6. Home or business address and Mailing address.

When finished, click Create vendor.
sources: Part 2 — Niural Pay > How to add a vendor

user: and for a bill instead?
answer:
To add a bill: Go to Niural Pay → Bills → Add bill. You can either use the Upload vendor invoice panel (drop a JPEG/PNG/PDF up to 10MB and Niural extracts vendor, amounts and dates), or fill the form manually:

1. Choose the vendor you want to pay (or + Add new vendor).
2. Pick the Contract to bill against (enables anomaly checks).
3. Select Entity and Department.
4. Enter Invoice details — Invoice number, Invoice date, Invoice currency, Due date.
5. Add Line items — Item, Quantity, Rate, Tax %, Discount %, Amount (use Add new item for more rows; totals calculate automatically).
6. Add Notes (500 characters) and any Additional attachments.
7. Click Next: Review details, check the summary, and confirm.

After creating, the bill appears with a Niural Invoice ID and the vendor’s number. If an approval policy applies it goes to Needs approval; otherwise it moves toward Ready for payment. Paying is a separate step — open the bill and use Pay invoice.
